title: Unreachable Multiples Pass-Code
src: Media.net OA, college not given (second set in the same shared note), problem 3 (the "GOAT-master" prison pass-code).
body:
You are given an N × N grid. Each cell holds a positive value (all distinct) or -1 for a blocked cell. From an open cell you can move up, down, left or right into another open cell.

For an open cell with value v, its sed-value is the sum of the values of all open cells that are multiples of v and are not reachable from it. A blocked cell's sed-value is -1.

Return the sum of all sed-values modulo 109 + 7, as a number in [0, 109 + 7).

Function to complete

Complete passCode(grid). It returns the sum of sed-values modulo 10^9 + 7.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: First line: N. Next N lines: the grid.
out: One integer: the sum of sed-values modulo 10<sup>9</sup> + 7 (non-negative).
cons: 1 ≤ A[i][j] ≤ 10<sup>6</sup>, or -1 for a blocked cell

wrong.why: gives blocked cells a sed-value of 0 instead of -1
sums every multiple, reachable or not

samples.ex: Regions: {1, 3}, {5}, {2, 6, 8, 7}, {10, 11}. Cell 1 sees 5 + 2 + 6 + 10 + 8 + 7 + 11 = 49; cell 3 sees 6; cell 5 sees 10; cell 2 sees 10; the others see 0. The 7 blocked cells add −7: 49 + 6 + 10 + 10 − 7 = 68.
A single open cell has nothing out of reach.
